purpose: Pure falsification of the frozen Dynamic State v5 candidate against frozen v4 on one newly opened historical block.
authorization: Explicit user instruction to continue after Dynamic State freeze on 2026-09-12 JST; consume only this single block and do not expand by outcome.
selectionRule: Ten chronological JPX sessions immediately preceding Block A, fixed before any Block C outcome is measured.

candidate.firstBarRule: directional close return < 0 enters DEFENSIVE; otherwise continue v4
candidate.recoveryRule: first completed managed close with directional return >= 0 by elapsed bar 6 promotes to RECOVERED and continues frozen v4
candidate.failureRule: no reclaim by elapsed bar 6 exits at completed bar-6 close

decisionRule.supportive: dynamic v5 net delta vs v4 > 0, PF >= v4 PF, drawdown not worse by more than 1 percentage point, and improvement not dominated by one trade
decisionRule.mixed: some benefit but one robustness criterion fails or sample is too small
decisionRule.reject: dynamic v5 net delta vs v4 <= 0 or materially worsens drawdown/premature-winner behavior
